text: 西尔维娅被那生物的冻结光线击中，无声倒下。你和诺曼冲进树木掩护，逃向树冠最浓密的一片区域。
飞行者似乎离开后，你们悄悄回到林边。西尔维娅和伯纳德的尸体都不见了。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 641
text: Without a sound, Sylvia goes down under the freezing energy of the creature’s ray. You and Norman reach the cover of the trees and head for a clump where the canopy is thickest.
Once the flyer seems to be gone, you creep back to the wood’s edge. The bodies of Sylvia and Bernard have vanished.
